prior_year_events.event_name: Arbitration re RITC of 2018 and 2019 underwriting years
prior_year_events.impact_description: Statement of claim issued for US$12.6m plus costs in respect of a dispute over the reinsurance to close of the 2018 and 2019 underwriting years of a previous syndicate reinsured into syndicate 1110; if arbitration succeeds it could crystallise a liability equal to that amount.

Potential recovery dispute which, if successful, could result in a reduction of GBP 75m in the reinsurers' share of technical provision and a reduction of GBP 20m in the amount due to reinsurers; net impact on the profit and loss could be a loss of GBP 55m.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 were GBP 468.278m. During 2024 there was an adverse movement in prior year estimates totalling a gross strengthening of GBP 83.868m (c. 17.9% of opening gross claims), driven largely by adverse development in casualty business, particularly US casualty lines. This movement is recorded gross (insurance liabilities) with a corresponding reinsurers' share reduction of GBP 46.548m.
raw_causal_phrases: adverse development of casualty business, particularly in the US.
Change in estimates of prior year provisions 83,868 (46,548) 37,320
Similar to the prior year the current year claims incurred of GBP 37.3m has largely been driven by adverse development of casualty business, particularly in the US.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement taken from the 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' gross column in the Technical Provisions reconciliation (explicit gross figure). There are active arbitration uncertainties (one US$12.6m claim and another potential recovery dispute implying up to GBP 55m net) that could materially affect reinsurance recoverables and net positions; amounts for the US$ arbitration were not converted to GBP and are left null. Claims development triangle and technical notes are presented in thousands in the report; all triangle data is taken verbatim from the gross claims development table (Note 15).
